item.title: Detection Is Not Early Warning: Evaluating Token-Level Alarms on Language Model Failures
item.description: Many failures of language models begin at a specific token, the onset. A monitor that reads the model during generation can classify the finished response, detect the failure once it is under way, or warn before it begins, and only a warning leaves time to stop or steer the generation. Monitors are usually evaluated with response-level metrics such as AUROC, which ignore when the monitor fires. We introduce PREWARN, an evaluation protocol for any failure with an annotated onset. item.title: Show HN: DeepSeek V3 in ~200 lines of pure Jax
Route coding agent requests to the right model on Amazon Bedrock with NVIDIA NeMo Switchyard
item.description: Coding agents work in tasks, and the number that matters is cost per solved task, not price per token. In this post, you use the AWS CDK to deploy LiteLLM with the NVIDIA NeMo Switchyard routing plugin on Amazon Bedrock, then measure cost per solved task for a routed model group against single-model baselines. — 来源：aws_ml · arxiv — 原文：https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/machine-learning/route-coding-agent-requests-to-the-right-model-on-amazon-bedrock-with-nvidia-nemo-switchyard/

item.title: Architecture patterns for fast session startup on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore runtime
item.description: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore runtime V2 snapshots your initialized environment and restores it for each new session, so session start no longer grows with image size. This post explains how V2 starts a session, how to measure session start time, and four patterns to keep work off the first request. — 来源：aws_ml — 原文：https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/machine-learning/architecture-patterns-for-fast-session-startup-on-amazon-bedrock-agentcore-runtime/

item.title: OpenFold3 on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart: Predict biomolecular structures
item.description: Deploy OpenFold3-preview from Amazon SageMaker JumpStart to predict 3D structures of proteins, DNA, RNA, and ligand complexes in your own AWS account. The post covers asynchronous inference, multi-GPU parallelism, bringing your own MSAs for accuracy and privacy, and scaling to zero to reduce cost. — 来源：aws_ml — 原文：https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/machine-learning/openfold3-on-amazon-sagemaker-jumpstart-predict-biomolecular-structures/
